question: Classify independent complete runs with 10000 expected scored trials and 10000 verified unique successful model responses each. Zero failures passes without a failure warning; 199/10000=1.99% passes with warning; 200/10000=2% and 201/10000=2.01% require parent review without success or automatic retry. 19999/1000000=1.9999% passes with warning even if displayed 2.00%. Preserve protocol-valid failures, scores and original denominators; tolerance does not establish negligible score impact.
expected_behavior: Applies each gate separately: 0% passes without a failure warning; 1.99% passes with a warning; exactly 2% and 2.01% require parent review without success or automatic retry
Accepts 1.9999% with a warning despite its rounded 2.00% display

question: A complete run has 1000 expected scored trials and 10000 verified unique successful model responses. Terminus-2 solver/harness timeouts affect trials 1-12, harness errors 9-16, and terminal action failures 15-19; artifacts prove these were not caused by incorrect model-generated code. Trials 21-220 have generated-code NameError/ValueError exceptions or sandbox timeouts; artifacts prove these were caused by incorrect model-generated code, including infinite loops, with healthy execution infrastructure and no response faults. Resumed logs duplicate these records. Model response faults affect IDs 1-120 (truncated), 81-170 (empty-final), and 151-190 (malformed). All failures are preserved protocol-valid incorrect/zero outcomes; other checks pass. A second run has the same response faults but 20 runtime-failed trials. Do not launch jobs.
